sink.caps: application/dash+xml:

bandwidth-usage.blurb: Percentage of the available bandwidth to use when selecting representations (deprecated)

max-bitrate.blurb: Max of bitrate supported by target video decoder (0 = no maximum)

max-buffering-time.blurb: Maximum number of seconds of buffer accumulated during playback(deprecated)

max-video-framerate.blurb: Max video framerate to select (0/1 = no maximum)

max-video-height.blurb: Max video height to select (0 = no maximum)

max-video-width.blurb: Max video width to select (0 = no maximum)

presentation-delay.blurb: Default presentation delay (in seconds, milliseconds or fragments) (e.g. 12s, 2500ms, 3f)

dashsink.author: Stéphane Cerveau <scerveau@collabora.com>
dashsink.description: Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP sink

min-buffer-time.blurb: Provides to the manifest a minimum buffer time in milliseconds

minimum-update-period.blurb: Provides to the manifest a minimum update period in milliseconds

mpd-baseurl.blurb: BaseURL to set in the MPD

mpd-filename.blurb: filename of the mpd to write

mpd-root-path.blurb: Path where the MPD and its fragments will be written

muxer.blurb: Muxer type to be used by dashsink to generate the fragment

period-duration.blurb: Provides the explicit duration of a period in milliseconds

send-keyframe-requests.blurb: Send keyframe requests to ensure correct fragmentation. If this is disabled then the input must have keyframes in regular intervals

suggested-presentation-delay.blurb: Provides to the manifest a suggested presentation delay in milliseconds

target-duration.blurb: The target duration in seconds of a segment/file. (0 - disabled, useful for management of segment duration by the streaming server)

use-segment-list.blurb: Use segment list instead of segment template to create the segments

afd-bar-line.blurb: Line number to use for inserting AFD/Bar data (0 = disabled)

cc-line.blurb: Line number to use for inserting closed captions (0 = disabled)

hw-serial-number.blurb: The serial number (hardware ID) of the Decklink card

mode.blurb: Video Mode to use for playback

output-vanc.blurb: Output ancillary data from input buffers

persistent-id.blurb: Output device instance to use. Higher priority than "device-number".

profile.blurb: Certain DeckLink devices such as the DeckLink 8K Pro, the DeckLink Quad 2 and the DeckLink Duo 2 support multiple profiles to configure the capture and playback behavior of its sub-devices.For the DeckLink Duo 2 and DeckLink Quad 2, a profile is shared between any 2 sub-devices that utilize the same connectors. For the DeckLink 8K Pro, a profile is shared between all 4 sub-devices. Any sub-devices that share a profile are considered to be part of the same profile group.DeckLink Duo 2 support configuration of the duplex mode of individual sub-devices.

timecode-format.blurb: Timecode format type to use for playback

video-format.blurb: Video format type to use for playback

buffer-size.blurb: Size of internal buffer in number of video frames

drop-no-signal-frames.blurb: Drop frames that are marked as having no input signal

hw-serial-number.blurb: The serial number (hardware ID) of the Decklink card

mode.blurb: Video Mode to use for playback

output-afd-bar.blurb: Extract and output AFD/Bar as GstMeta (if present)

output-cc.blurb: Extract and output CC as GstMeta (if present)

output-stream-time.blurb: Output stream time directly instead of translating to pipeline clock

output-vanc.blurb: Extract and output VANC as GstMeta (if present)

persistent-id.blurb: Output device instance to use. Higher priority than "device-number".

profile.blurb: Certain DeckLink devices such as the DeckLink 8K Pro, the DeckLink Quad 2 and the DeckLink Duo 2 support multiple profiles to configure the capture and playback behavior of its sub-devices.For the DeckLink Duo 2 and DeckLink Quad 2, a profile is shared between any 2 sub-devices that utilize the same connectors. For the DeckLink 8K Pro, a profile is shared between all 4 sub-devices. Any sub-devices that share a profile are considered to be part of the same profile group.DeckLink Duo 2 support configuration of the duplex mode of individual sub-devices.

signal.blurb: True if there is a valid input signal available

skip-first-time.blurb: Skip that much time of initial frames after starting

timecode-format.blurb: Timecode format type to use for input

video-format.blurb: Video format type to use for input (Only use auto for mode=auto)

blocksize.blurb: Size in bytes to pull per buffer (0 = default)

last-sample.blurb: The last sample received in the sink

layer-mode.blurb: The cooperative level handling the access permission (set this to 'administrative' when the cursor is required)

max-bitrate.blurb: The maximum bits per second to render (0 = disabled)

max-lateness.blurb: Maximum number of nanoseconds that a buffer can be late before it is dropped (-1 unlimited)

pixel-aspect-ratio.blurb: The pixel aspect ratio of the device

processing-deadline.blurb: Maximum processing time for a buffer in nanoseconds

render-delay.blurb: Additional render delay of the sink in nanoseconds

show-preroll-frame.blurb: Whether to render video frames during preroll

throttle-time.blurb: The time to keep between rendered buffers (0 = disabled)

vsync.blurb: Wait for next vertical sync to draw frames
